sizing_context: Historical case: Druckenmiller had built a large short GBP position before the trigger; after Schlesinger's comments, Soros pushed for an aggressive increase rather than gradual scaling.
sizing_principle: Special-situation macro sizing: when downside is bounded by the peg/band and the trigger makes devaluation highly likely, sizing can be much larger than ordinary position sizing, subject to liquidity and reserve-capacity constraints.
risk_capacity_notes: The source case frames the maximum adverse movement as limited by the ERM band and the fund's year-to-date profits; this is not a generic rule for normal FX trades.
human_notes: This eval is historical and should teach recognition of rare asymmetric policy-break trades, not routine leverage.
